patch.value: GH-1440: validate linked-test context at write time and distinguish execution refusals

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1440 reports that a linked command using pm_context_mode=none with the default source workspace is accepted when added and later refused as assertion_failure with exit_code=1 even though the subprocess never ran. Existing none-mode execution isolation from pm-t05d8d remains completed; this new work concerns write-time validation and truthful refusal classification across CLI, SDK and persisted legacy records.

Both add transports and SDK mutations reject none mode without an isolated or snapshot workspace and preserve tracker/history bytes on refusal; legacy invalid records remain non-executable and report a typed config refusal with null exit status; real executed command failures retain assertion_failure and their actual exit codes; public SDK types, contracts, JSON/TOON output, docs and installed Node/Bun behavior agree.

Invalid linked context combinations are refused before metadata persistence with a concrete isolated or snapshot recovery; execution still safely rejects legacy invalid records using a configuration-refusal category and no fabricated subprocess exit status.
